generated.prop: plaster test wall with subtle finish variation
generated.details: Its continuous plaster surface has overlapping troweled test patches with subtle differences in sheen and texture.
On the mid-plane left tabletop, one small ceramic test tile lies flat, its cream glazed face meeting a thin exposed fired-clay edge.
Farther back on the mid-plane far-left tabletop, a studio task lamp has a weighted base, jointed metal arm and attached shallow shade aimed at the tile.
